Proposals.Development: Adrian completes the second and third days of the trial, receiving regular payments and establishing a routine of daily specimen collection and medication intake. He experiences increased physical capabilities and hunger, which he manages within his limited resources, while the clinic's monitoring systems note minor variances in his samples that are accepted as within parameters.
Proposals.Evidence: He just knew that he was alive. And he was paid. And that was enough.
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: Adrian has completed the second and third days of the trial, receiving regular payments and establishing a routine of daily specimen collection and medication intake. He is aware of the subtle changes in his body and the clinic's monitoring systems, but he is unaware of the deeper changes the medication is causing in his body.
Proposals.ProposedNextMilestone: Adrian completes the final days of the trial, managing the escalating physical side effects of the medication and the logistical challenges of balancing the trial with his academic and part-time obligations, while the clinic's monitoring systems begin to flag significant anomalies in his samples.
